items.label: Versatile Storage Solution
items.value: This office cabinet combines open shelving and 3 drawers to neatly organize paperwork, supplies, or household items. The top two drawers are sized for smaller essentials, while the spacious bottom drawer accommodates larger folders. The durable top surface provides extra space for printers or scanners, making it ideal for home offices, living rooms, or studios.

items.label: Sturdy & Durable Design
items.value: Crafted from thick MDF board, this furniture supports up to 330 lbs, ensuring long-lasting stability. The scratch-resistant, water-repellent finish maintains a sleek look while standing up to daily wear—perfect for busy homes or offices.

items.label: Smooth Operation
items.value: To enhance user convenience, the drawers of the lateral file cabinet organizer feature smooth sliding tracks that allow for easy opening and closing, making it easier for you to access and organize files. This design not only improves work efficiency but also provides a seamless archiving experience.

items.label: Easy Mobility
items.value: This rolling file cabinet features 4 smooth-gliding casters (including 2 lockable front wheels)—effortless to move when unlocked, yet firmly stable when secured. Perfect for flexible office layouts.

items.label: Assembly Tip
items.value: This wood printer stand includes all hardware and tools, but we recommend checking parts against the manual first. For easiest assembly, have two people work together and use an electric drill for faster installation.
